about: How long a lead stays in time, when its hand-off goes to the firm's fallback, how long a delivery keeps retrying, and how long an accepted CRM record may stay unfound by a lookup before it is flagged. Set by Answering AI, not by firms; the decisions behind each value are in answers.md (Speed: window to act, fallback, holding). Embedded into the backend (Timing.fs); a deployment may point DELIVERY_TIMING_FILE at its own copy. Durations: a number and s, m, h or d.
